```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  year = 2020,
  state = "TX",
  geometry = TRUE
)
```


```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income in Texas Counties",
    subtitle = "2016-2020 American Community Survey",
    caption = "Source: US Census Bureau",
    fill = "Income"
  )
```
```{r}
#| message: false
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(
    "B15003_001",
    "B15003_022",
    "B15003_023",
    "B15003_024",
    "B15003_025"
  ),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 12
#| fig-width: 10
edu_state |>
  filter(
    NAME != "Puerto Rico",
    variable %in% c("B15003_022", "B15003_023", "B15003_024", "B15003_025")
  ) |>
  group_by(NAME) |>
  summarise(
    percent = sum(estimate) / first(summary_est) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(NAME = reorder(NAME, percent)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = NAME, y = percent)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = percent), width = 0.78, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = scales::percent(percent / 100, accuracy = 1)),
    hjust = -0.18,
    size = 2.7,
    color = "#243447"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Bachelor's Degree or Higher by State",
    subtitle = "Share of adults with a bachelor's degree or higher",
    x = "State",
    y = "Adults with a bachelor's degree or higher (%)",
    caption = "Source: US Census Bureau, 2016-2020 American Community Survey"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#F7F8FC", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F7F8FC", color = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, color = "#18243A"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#52627A"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#DCE2EC"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, color = "#52627A")
  )
```

## California Median Age

```{r}
#| message: false
ca_age <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = c("B01002_001", "B01003_001"),
  year = 2020,
  state = "CA",
  output = "wide",
  geometry = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
ca_age |>
  select(
    NAME,
    median_age = B01002_001E,
    population = B01003_001E
  ) |>
  mutate(
    team = case_when(
      NAME == "Los Angeles County, California" ~ "LA Chargers + Rams",
      NAME == "San Francisco County, California" ~ "San Francisco 49ers",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = population, y = median_age)) +
  geom_point(color = "#AAB4C3", alpha = 0.75, size = 2.5) +
  geom_point(
    data = \(data) filter(data, !is.na(team)),
    aes(fill = team),
    shape = 21,
    color = "#F9C74F",
    stroke = 1.2,
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = \(data) filter(data, !is.na(team)),
    aes(label = stringr::str_remove(NAME, ", California")),
    color = "#142B4A",
    fontface = "bold",
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "California NFL spotlight",
    values = c(
      "LA Chargers + Rams" = "#2878B5",
      "San Francisco 49ers" = "#AA0000"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "California Counties: A West Coast Football Rivalry",
    subtitle = "Chargers and Rams in Los Angeles; 49ers in San Francisco",
    x = "County population (log scale)",
    y = "Median age (years)",
    caption = "Source: ACS 5-year estimates via tidycensus"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#F4F7FC", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F4F7FC", color = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#142B4A", size = 17),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#46566C"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#DCE3ED"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#142B4A", face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#142B4A"),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "#46566C", hjust = 0)
  )
```
